title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description**

Cybroque Technologies is a technology company specializing in software development, web technologies, and AI-driven automation. We build scalable digital solutions and innovative products that help businesses grow and adapt. Our team provides an environment for learning, collaboration, and real-world project experience.

**Role Description**

This is a hybrid internship opportunity based at HiLITE Business Park, Calicut. The Graphic Designer Intern will create visual assets for digital platforms, including social media creatives, marketing materials, branding elements, logos, and UI graphics. The role involves collaborating with developers and other team members to maintain consistent visual quality across company projects.

**Qualifications**

* Good skills in graphic design, branding, and logo design.
* Knowledge of typography, layouts, and visual composition.
* Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of digital and web design principles.
* Creativity, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work collaboratively, meet deadlines, and accept feedback.
* A portfolio or samples of previous design work is preferred.

title: Branding & Creative Designer
description:
**We’re Hiring — Branding & Creative Designer**

**Creoture**
is looking for a Branding & Creative Designer to work with us on a project-based, hybrid basis.

We’re not looking for a specific number of years of experience. What matters to us is how you think, what you create, and the quality of your work.

**What you’ll work on**

• Brand identities, logos & visual systems

• Marketing, social media & campaign creatives

• Creative concepts & visual directions

• Digital & print design

• Brand guidelines & communication assets

• Taking ideas from concept to final execution

**What we’re looking for**

• Strong understanding of branding, typography, layout & composition

• Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools

• Strong conceptual and creative thinking

• Good visual sense and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

• A portfolio that demonstrates your creative ability

**Role Details**

📍

Kozhikode, Kerala

Hybrid

📌

Interested? DM us your portfolio to apply.
